description: File-operation outcomes beside the database outcome: p1's FileData is saved to a new work file; saved onto a work file that already exists (written by ADODB.Stream); LoadFromFile of a source that does not exist; SaveToFile on the child of the empty group p3; LoadFromFile whose source is the open database file itself; SaveToFile whose destination is the open database file. Files are observed after each step; the group is read at the end.
retentionNote: Designed r-cplx-rebuild probe (A-02); complete capture of the ACE answer.
